PullRequest.Title: copilot: remove unused modules and helper APIs
PullRequest.Body:
Refs https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog/issues/9678

Combine 18 verified Copilot Chat dead-code cleanup groups into one PR. Remove seven unreferenced modules and unused declarations from twelve live modules, including their exclusive dependencies. No runtime behavior, configuration registrations, policies, or public extension API changes are intended.

### Removed modules

- The unused ignore-info content provider and duplicate ignored-files message module. The live message in `platform/ignore/common/ignoreService.ts` remains.
- Unused ask-questions response interfaces, task-representation helper, and rich-chat request-options interface. The separate live CLI/core implementations and types remain.
- Both unused TypeScript `NullContextProvider` implementations (server plugin and TS7).

### Removed declarations from live modules

- The unused nearby-cursor token-processing subsystem: `Tokens`, `Token`, `LineWithTokens`, six token/range helpers, and exclusive imports. Keep the selection-deduction functions used by `xtabProvider`.
- Seven unused validator factories (`vObjAny`, `vNull`, `vUnchecked`, `vUnknown`, `vTuple`, `vLiteral`, `vLazy`) and the exclusive `vObjAnyValidator` singleton. Preserve `NullValidator` and `vNullValidator`, which the live `vNullable` factory uses.
- Nine unused length helpers: `lengthDiff`, `lengthGetLineCount`, `lengthGetColumnCountIfZeroLineCount`, `lengthToPosition`, `lengthOfRange`, `lengthCompare`, `lengthOfStringObj`, `lengthHash`, and `lengthMax`. Preserve the live edit-composition helpers.
- `isTerminalService`, `isNullTerminalService`, and the unused `MockWorkspaceIndexStateReporter` plus its exclusive `Emitter` import.
- `decodeSessionId`, `getReferencedFiles`, and `checkInString` plus its exclusive `SnippyWindowSize` constant.
- `sendSuggestionShownTelemetryData`, `shouldDoParsingTrimming`, `getAllConfigKeys`, and `getDiagnosticsAtSelection`.

Scenarios.Scenario: Extension activation and loading of the changed configuration, validator, session, terminal, telemetry, and utility modules
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Synchronous module parse/evaluation is on activation or first-import paths. The diff only removes declarations; repository-wide searches found no remaining consumers of the removed exports or deleted modules. The only removed top-level runtime work is construction of one unused TypeofValidator, so no new work blocks activation.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Source/bundle size and number of imported modules; the changed runtime cardinality is zero additional operations and one fewer unused validator allocation at most.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Module evaluation is synchronous and singleton-scoped by the module loader; the diff adds no tasks, queues, or parallel work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Loaded modules are cached by the module system and are not reevaluated on warm use. The diff does not change application cache keys, misses, invalidation, coalescing, or negative caching.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: every hunk is a deletion, removed symbols have zero repository references, and no replacement initialization was added.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact emitted bundle-size reduction depends on the build's tree-shaking, but that uncertainty only affects the size of a possible improvement, not the absence of a regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The change removes dormant source and may marginally reduce parse/evaluation work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Next-edit request after typing, including cursor/selection deduction and model streaming
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Each next-edit attempt calls getOrDeduceSelectionFromLastEdit before context gathering and the streamed model request. The retained selection helper is unchanged; the deleted token-processing classes and range helpers had no callers and therefore were not on this path before the diff.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Start the streamed next-edit model request with endpoint.makeChatRequest2
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One request per provider attempt, plus only the pre-existing explicit retry paths; deleted helpers have effective cardinality zero.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same endpoint call occurred with the same per-attempt cardinality; the removed token subsystem was never invoked.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The request is the dominant asynchronous boundary for producing streamed edits, but selection deduction remains local CPU work before it.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of next-edit attempts and document edits. Added work remains zero at every frequency and document size.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The primary model stream remains one endpoint request per provider attempt, with existing retry/cancellation behavior unchanged. The diff adds no parallel work or limiter changes.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache read, write, key, or invalidation behavior changed. Provider request caching/coalescing is unaffected because the changed module only lost unreachable declarations.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the sole live importer uses only the unchanged getOrDeduceSelectionFromLastEdit export, and exact searches found no consumers of the deleted subsystem.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material for causality; request latency varies, but the diff does not alter whether or how often the request occurs.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression; hot-path CPU and network cardinality are unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Post-insertion Snippy matching and citation lookup
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After a qualifying insertion, local lexeme checks construct the source, then one match request must complete; any returned snippets trigger citation-detail requests before logging. The diff removes only the unreferenced checkInString helper and SnippyWindowSize constant, while all live lexeme functions are unchanged.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: POST the inserted source for Snippy matching
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One request per qualifying post-insertion invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Identical one-request behavior before the diff; the deleted local helper was not called.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before the service knows whether citation lookups are needed.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: POST each returned snippet cursor to fetch matching-file details
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: S requests for S snippets returned by the match response, launched together by Promise.all in snippyServiceImpl.ts.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Identical S-request fan-out and concurrency before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: All citation requests settle before citation logging completes.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Frequency of qualifying insertions and server-returned snippet count S; the diff contributes zero additional CPU or network work.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One match request runs first, followed by S citation requests concurrently through Promise.all for S returned snippets. This pre-existing fan-out is unchanged by the diff.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is present in the inspected Snippy service/fetcher path, and the diff neither adds retries nor changes warm/cold behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the live service imports the module namespace but calls only retained functions, and exact searches found no checkInString or SnippyWindowSize use.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The server-controlled snippet count varies, but both its effective cardinality and concurrency are unchanged.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression; existing boundary fan-out is pre-existing and untouched.

Scenarios.Scenario: Workspace semantic-index status initialization and refresh
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Status construction requests index state. On a cold authenticated start, service initialization awaits preferred embedding-type discovery; once initialized, getIndexState reads the existing remote-index state locally. The diff only deletes an unreferenced mock reporter and its emitter import, leaving the live reporter, event listener, and update method unchanged.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch available embedding models during cold workspace-search initialization
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One coalesced request on a cold successful lookup; a permissive-session retry can issue one additional request after an initial unsuccessful response. Successful results remain cached.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same cached lookup and retry behavior existed; removing the unused mock does not select or alter the live service.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Cold status initialization can await this discovery before displaying the resolved state; warm state reads avoid the network boundary.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Extension cold starts, authentication changes, and index-state events; changed work is zero per event.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Concurrent cold consumers share the embedding-type service's cached Promise; successful discovery is coalesced to one request. Status refreshes remain independently requested but read local state after initialization. The diff changes neither behavior.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: A Promise cache coalesces concurrent model discovery and retains successful results; failed results clear for later retry. The diff does not touch this lifecycle.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the contribution still instantiates ChatStatusWorkspaceIndexingStatus, which still uses IWorkspaceChunkSearchService; no live code referenced the deleted mock.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Authentication and cold-start prevalence affect latency, but there is no changed mechanism or cardinality.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression; live initialization, caching, event debounce, and boundary count are unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Inline-edit length composition and other local parsing/validation helpers
Scenarios.CriticalPath: TextLengthEdit composition still calls the retained length conversion and combination helpers. Chat patch parsing, diagnostics filtering, configuration validation, and session/terminal utilities retain their live entry points. All removed helper exports have zero repository references, so they had no execution cardinality before or after the diff.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Edit count, text length, diagnostics count, response length, and configuration object size; the changed declarations execute zero times for all input sizes.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: These reached operations are synchronous local CPU work; no changed async scheduling or concurrency exists.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No changed cache or memoization behavior is present. Removing unused factories does not alter validators constructed by retained call sites.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: exact repository searches found no consumers of any removed length, validator, diagnostics, session, patch, terminal, telemetry, or configuration helper.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Call frequencies of the retained helpers vary by editing and chat activity, but their code and inputs are unchanged.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression; collection-scaling CPU and serialization behavior remain unchanged.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all 19 changed files and every diff hunk. The PR removes unreferenced modules, exports, imports, and one unused top-level validator allocation; it adds no runtime work, retained state, boundary calls, scheduling, or cache changes. No findings or regression-fix learning records were warranted.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
